features.name: Create New Deposit
details:
Request new deposit and this can be of two types:
 .Regular Term Deposit 
 .Term Deposit Monthly Interest (Capital Return)

features.name: Top-Up Existing Deposit
details: Add additional funds to an existing deposit

features.name: Fully Break Existing Deposit (Currently Disabled)
details: Withdraw the entire deposit amount and close deposit account

features.name: Partially Break Existing Deposit (Currently Disabled)
details: Withdraw a partial amount of the deposit
Note: only available for regular term deposit

features.name: Manage Deposit
details:
Control settings of deposit including: 
 .Accounts
.Auto Renewal
